title: Pal Dot Dance
style: Alternative R&B fused with dembow groove, midtempo swing and skittering syncopated percussion; verse rides sparse sub-bass and clipped handclaps, pre-chorus lifts with pitched vocal stacks and a filtered synth swell, chorus drops into a bouncy half-time bounce with chanty ad-libs. High lead vocals with doubled hooks, playful call-and-response, tiny reverse whooshes, rim-click fills, and glossy bright mix with tight low end., alternative r&b, rap, latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Clap, then rap it back
Rappal.app, tap that
Rap pal dot app
You got that?

Sing it back, pal
Say it right now
Rap back, dance back
Spin me around

Latin America, pal
Feel that sway
Palm to palm now
We don't play

[Pre-Chorus]
Ooh, I hear you now
Ooh, say it loud
Pal by pal
We crowd the sound

[Chorus]
Pal rap back
Pal rap back
Wanna dance, pal
Wanna dance, pal

Pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance

([pal rap back])
([wanna dance, pal])

[Verse 2]
Kid-computer voice
High and bright
Quick little sparks
In the night

Clap on the one
Step on the two
You say my line
I say it too

Rappal.app
Keeps on ringing
Pal to the left
Pal still singing

[Pre-Chorus]
Ooh, I hear you now
Ooh, say it loud
Pal by pal
We crowd the sound

[Chorus]
Pal rap back
Pal rap back
Wanna dance, pal
Wanna dance, pal

Pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance

([pal rap back])
([pal dot dance])

[Bridge]
Call me back in rhythm
Call me back in time
If you say pal twice
I know it's mine

[Break]
Clap
Rap
Pal
Dance

[Final Chorus]
Pal rap back
Pal rap back
Wanna dance, pal
Wanna dance, pal

Pal dot dance
Pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance
Go to pal dot dance

Rappal.app
Rappal.app
You got that now
You got that now
